title: Freeze-readiness evidence for the shared-kernel catalog

role_assignments._run_id_disambiguation: /claude/r0_steward (Anthropic) is THIS package's Integration Owner and must record its own capability declaration before this package leaves backlog. /root/r0_steward (OpenAI Codex) is a DIFFERENT run: it is the Integration Owner of WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-CON-001 and is named in open_blockers solely because it must countersign the amendments made to those two packages and record the WP-0A-CON-001 npm run check addendum. Neither run substitutes for the other. Independent testing flagged the near-identical names as ambiguous; both are intended.

independence.cross_vendor_exception: prefer_cross_vendor_review is NOT satisfied: every assigned run is Anthropic claude-opus-5. The Decision Register (§ cross-vendor review) permits this only as an explicit exception - 'if there is no cross-vendor capacity, use an independent agent per run and record the exception'. Each of the five roles is a separate agent run with its own capability declaration and no run reviewed, tested, or integrated its own work. The Integration Owner must carry this exception forward; it is not waived and it is not equivalent to cross-vendor review.

required_human_authorities: A6 sign-off for CTR-AUD-001, CTR-OBS-001 and CTR-USG-001
purpose: Ten shared-kernel contracts are still Draft, and the Decision Register permits only exploratory spikes against a Draft contract. Every consumer package waiting to build a fake or a consumer test is blocked on that, while nine of the ten already carry the schema and fixtures Candidate v1 asks for. This package gathers the evidence for each contract against its OWN required_before_freeze list and puts it in front of the owners. It changes no status: promotion is a decision its owner and the Product Owner make.

include: RFC-2026-010 recording, per contract, which required_before_freeze items are present and by what artifact
An explicit statement of what the check does NOT establish, item by item
Routing of the four co-owned contracts to A1 and A6 rather than promoting them
A machine-written verification record, and the runner-side check that a stale record fails the build
A branch-scope guard: what a branch CHANGED, checked against what its package declares
A pinned catalog registry: every contract's freeze level, owner and freeze requirements, and the index that must agree with them
Conformance and truthfulness checks over every author handoff
A command that rebuilds the integrity manifest, which four documents already told someone to do without one existing
exclude: Any change to a contract status, in a manifest, in the catalog index or in the Decision Register
CTR-NTF-001, which A5 owns and which this package does not assess
Mutation coverage as a promotion criterion; it is quoted as context and is not a bar
Production schema, migrations, provider calls and every other Gate G0 restriction

amends_without_owning.rationale: Regenerates WP-0A-A0-006's author handoff, whose cited commits the squash merge of PR #45 orphaned, plus the two floors that move with any protected-file edit. A0-006 is merged and has no branch left to regenerate itself from. No claim in that handoff is changed; only the range it cites and the file lists derived from it.

acceptance_criteria: Every required_before_freeze item is assessed against the shipped schema and fixture list, not against a fixture count.
The assessment states plainly that it establishes PRESENCE of an artifact and not that the artifact satisfies the intent behind the phrase, with the specific items where that gap is widest named.
No contract status changes anywhere in the repository.
Contracts with a co-owner are routed to that co-owner rather than proposed for promotion by A0 alone.
npm run check stays green with no test skipped.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. One decision record and one manifest; no code, no contract, no schema and no status changed.
open_blockers: RFC-2026-010 is Proposed. Until the Product Owner disposes of it, every contract stays Draft and consumers stay limited to exploratory spikes.
A1 and A6 sign-off is outstanding for four contracts and cannot be represented by an agent.

The freeze check establishes presence, not sufficiency. Four items are named in the RFC where a script cannot see what the phrase meant: stable ordering, auth rules, decimal money and bounded cardinality.
CTR-NTF-001 remains unassessed; A5 owns it.
